title: Stage-4 evaluation governance isolation -- completion QA / red-team
frozen_head_subject: add Stage 4 evaluation governance and isolation gates
delta_explanation: 1567 - 1534 = 33 new collected red-team cases. No pre-existing test modified, weakened, or removed. Only tests/second_brain/test_stage4_evaluation_red_team.py and this artifact were touched.

A1_benchmark_item_as_serving_content_dig.description: Benchmark or holdout item digest injected as serving content_digest must refuse isolation (package assert and live service proof).

A2_shared_key_or_capability.description: Shared key or capability between benchmark/holdout/serving must refuse (package assert and service constructor).

A3_overlapping_item_sets.description: Overlapping benchmark/holdout item sets (including subset) must refuse.

A4_slo_below_plan_minima.description: SLO construction refuses shadow days 13, parity cases 199, e2e 499, safety>0, and any denominator flag false; exact plan minima construct.

A5_external_reflection_disabled.description: External reflection when route disabled refuses; local reflection always ok at package and service layers.

A6_export_disabled_unknown_withhold.description: Export to disabled/unknown destination refuses; withheld+destination construction refuses; withhold-then-export refuses.

A7_support_withdrawal_selective.description: Support withdrawal removes only dependent proposals; unrelated proposals remain (package + service).

A8_governance_digest_tamper_slo_mismatch.description: Governance digest tamper, body field swap without redigest, mismatched slo_digest, SLO/benchmark digest tamper, and unbound benchmark refuse.

A9_live_lifecycle_isolation_proof.description: Live isolation proof against a real LifecycleLedgerAuthority snapshot passes when corpora are disjoint; workspace mismatch and eval key-as-serving-key refuse.
